title: Delta 2.5 Hz | Deep Sleep, Inner Restoration
description:
Deep sleep, inner restoration.

Delta is the slowest band the brain produces, roughly 0.5 to 4 Hz, and it dominates during the deepest stage of non REM sleep. In that window the brain clears metabolic waste through the glymphatic system, consolidates memory, and releases growth hormone. A binaural beat at 2.5 Hz presents two nearly identical tones, one per ear, so the auditory brainstem resolves a phantom pulse at the difference frequency and firing patterns across the cortex begin to follow it.

This session: 200 Hz in the left ear, 202.5 Hz in the right ear, so the beat lands at 2.5 Hz. Length 65 seconds.

Headphones are required, since the two ears have to hear two different tones for the phantom beat to exist. Listen at a comfortable volume.

Cognistration is an exploration tool, not a medical device, and nothing here is a treatment for any condition. If you have a seizure disorder, tinnitus, or a hearing concern, talk to a clinician before experimenting with tones.
